issues.description: Function simulate_msd_two_rounds has inconsistent parameters across artifacts. The problem statement declares simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) (problem_statement.md), and the solution implementation in solution_repository/msd.py defines def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]: (line 240). The template implementation in template_repository/msd.py, however, declares def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots:int, p: float) -> tuple[float, float]: (line 134) and thus omits the optional batch_size parameter. This mismatch will confuse students and/or make it difficult to implement or run the two-round batched simulation described in the statement and used by the reference solution and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template signature match the problem statement and the solution by adding the optional batch_size parameter with a default value. Change the template declaration to: def simulate_msd_two_rounds(n_shots: int, p: float, batch_size: int = 1000000) -> tuple[float, float]: and update the template docstring to describe batch_size. Alternatively, if batching is not intended, update the problem statement and the solution to remove batch_size and keep a consistent two-argument signature across all artifacts.
